purpose: Rank legally accepted, reproducible OYYO Mini and Nano engineering candidates on a common evidence model.

hard_gates.description: Source, revision, transformations and rights are recorded and accepted.
Training, fine-tuning, distillation or other intended adaptation rights are accepted.
Candidate package artifacts are hash verified.
Candidate loads through the OYYO native provider shell.
Declared structured-output/tool capability passes contract tests.
Required OYYO workflows execute with third-party AI providers disabled.

mini.role: first executable engineering vehicle for laptop/desktop OYYO

nano.role: edge/constrained optimization line following the Mini pipeline

ranking_rule: A candidate is rankable only after every hard gate is true and every family metric is present. The independence gate is derived only from validated independence evidence and cannot be self-asserted by a candidate file. Eligible candidates rank by weighted normalized score descending.
notes: Compare performance metrics on the same declared hardware profile.
Ranges are N0/N1 engineering normalization bands, not product promises.
Public leaderboard position and raw parameter count are not selection gates.
Mini independence requires chat, structured output, tool calling and translation under the native provider contract. Nano currently requires chat, structured output and translation.
